content_studio_setup_manual_intro: Fill in what you can; you can leave any part out and add it later under Brand & AI.
content_studio_setup_names_required: Every profile you keep needs a name.
content_studio_setup_pitch: Tell us about your company in a few sentences. AI drafts your brand description, writing style, audiences and editorial rules; you review and adjust them. It takes about 5 minutes.
content_studio_setup_ready_hint: You can change all of it later under Brand & AI. Every AI suggestion now starts from it.
content_studio_setup_review_hint: This is what will be saved. Nothing is deleted or overwritten: changed profiles get a new version and keep their history.
content_studio_setup_save_retry: What was saved stays saved; Save again continues with the rest.
content_studio_setup_saves_brand: Saved as the identity of your Brand Kit; its colors and fonts stay as they are.
content_studio_setup_saves_named: A new profile, or a new version of the profile with this name.
content_studio_setup_saves_policy: A new version of your editorial policy; earlier versions stay in its history.
content_studio_setup_subtitle: A few questions about your company; AI drafts your content profile and you review it. You can stop at any time and continue later.
content_studio_template_package_hint: The new design starts as a copy of this template revision with the text of package version
content_studio_template_package_image_ch: An image of the package is chosen.
content_studio_template_package_text_fie: Field for the text of version
content_studio_template_package_text_lay: This template has no text field: the text is added as a text layer on the first page, exactly as saved.
content_studio_writing_avoid_hint: Add why, so colleagues and the AI know what to write instead.
content_studio_writing_avoid_reason_plac: e.g. Sounds like hype. Name the concrete benefit instead.
content_studio_writing_donts_hint: What never fits, e.g. "No exclamation marks in headlines".
content_studio_writing_dos_hint: Concrete habits, e.g. "Open with the reader's problem".
content_studio_writing_empty_hint: A writing profile tells the AI and your team how your brand sounds: voice, perspective, words to use and avoid.
content_studio_writing_first_plural_hint: The team speaks as one: "We build…", "Our approach…".
content_studio_writing_first_singular_hi: One person speaks: "I helped a client…". For founders and freelancers.
content_studio_writing_mixed_hint: Switches on purpose, usually we for the company and you for the reader. Describe the mix under Voice.
content_studio_writing_perspective_none_: No fixed perspective: the AI chooses per post.
content_studio_writing_prefer_hint: Words and phrases that sound like you.
content_studio_writing_second_hint: Posts talk to the reader: "You can…", "Your team…".
content_studio_writing_third_hint: Neutral, about the company: "Acme builds…", "They offer…".
content_studio_ai_created_attention: AI connection saved, but it does not work yet.
content_studio_ai_key_replaced_attention: API key replaced, but the connection does not work yet.
content_studio_ai_model_retired: The previously selected model is no longer available. Choose another with Edit; until then the recommended model is used.
content_studio_ai_model_retired_choose: The previously selected model is no longer available. Choose another.
content_studio_ai_test_workspace: This Anthropic key is not tied to a workspace. Add the workspace ID (it starts with wrkspc_) with Replace key, or use a key created inside a workspace.
content_studio_ai_workspace_id_hint: Only for an Anthropic key that is not tied to one workspace. You find the ID in the Claude Console under Settings, Workspaces.
content_studio_creative_intro_brand: Apply your Brand Kit colors and fonts, and let AI suggest text.
content_studio_creative_intro_edit: Add text, images from your media library, rectangles and ellipses; add pages for a carousel.
content_studio_creative_intro_render: Render each page as an image into your media library, ready to add to a post.
content_studio_creative_intro_start: Start from a blank design in a social media size, or from a template.
content_studio_creative_intro_title: Create on-brand visuals for your content
content_studio_design_media_unsupported: This file type cannot be used in a design. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
content_studio_setup_ai_error_invalid: The AI answer could not be used. Try again.
content_studio_setup_ai_error_model: This model is not available for this connection. Choose another model under Fix connection.
content_studio_setup_ai_error_rejected: {{provider}} could not accept the request Content Studio sent. Try again; if it keeps happening, choose another model under Check AI connection.
content_studio_setup_ai_error_timeout: The AI provider took too long to answer. Try again; a faster model can help.
content_studio_setup_ai_error_unavailabl: The AI provider is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
content_studio_setup_ai_error_workspace: This Anthropic key is not tied to a workspace. Add the workspace ID to the connection, or use a key created inside a workspace.
content_studio_setup_ai_fallback: Content Studio works best with AI. Without it you fill in your profile yourself.
content_studio_setup_ai_untested: This connection has not been tested yet.
content_studio_setup_ai_untested_member: An admin can test this connection under Brand & AI.
content_studio_setup_website_error: Use a full URL, for example https://nextlevelweb.nl
content_studio_design_small_screen: Creative Studio editing works best on a larger screen. You can look at this design here; open it on a computer or tablet to edit it.
content_studio_setup_tagline_hint: Your slogan or one line about what you stand for. AI keeps it as you wrote it; leave it empty and AI suggests one.
content_studio_setup_tried_again: Tried again just now ({{count}} tries): the same problem came back.
content_studio_setup_generating_hint_bac: This takes about a minute. You can switch to another app: we keep working and show the result when you are back.
content_studio_setup_first_post_intro: Content Studio can now use your company profile, audience and expertise to research a relevant topic and create your first post. You can review it, edit it and decide whether to schedule it or publish it.
content_studio_setup_save_intro: Your profile is ready to save. Every AI suggestion in Content Studio starts from it.
content_studio_first_post_error_rate: The AI provider is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
content_studio_first_post_error_timeout: The AI did not finish in time. Try again.
content_studio_first_post_error_invalid: The AI answer could not be used. Try again.
content_studio_first_post_error_connecti: The AI connection needs attention. Check it under Brand & AI, then try again.
content_studio_first_post_error: The AI provider is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
content_studio_refine_look_for_why: Content Studio uses this to decide which topics are worth bringing to you: developments in your subjects, changes in your industry, questions your audience has, new rules, practical applications.
content_studio_refine_avoid_why: Topics named here are never suggested, for example generic AI news, consumer news, hype, other markets or countries, or subjects you never want to cover.
content_studio_refine_freshness_why: Recent news gives you a reason to post today; a lasting topic with a current hook stays useful for longer.
content_studio_refine_angles_why: The angle decides what your post adds: advice, an explanation, your opinion, an analysis, an example. Choose the ones that sound like you.
content_studio_first_post_no_sources: No current source was found: this post builds on your expertise, not on news.
content_studio_first_post_check_sources: Check the sources before you publish: AI can misread them.
content_studio_refine_conflict: Your editorial policy changed elsewhere. Try again to use the latest one.
content_studio_refine_save_error: Your research preferences could not be saved. Try again.
content_studio_first_post_approval: Your editorial policy asks for approval first. Ask for a review of this post, then schedule it.
content_studio_first_post_handoff_error: Your post could not be opened in the composer. Your draft is kept; try again.
content_studio_first_post_subtitle: Researched with your profile, written in your voice. You stay in control: nothing is published or scheduled until you choose to.
content_studio_first_post_no_ai: Content Studio needs a working AI connection for this.
content_studio_first_post_refine_hint: Change what Content Studio looks for before creating another draft.
content_studio_first_post_saved_not_star: Your profile is saved, but we couldn't create the first post yet.
content_studio_first_post_intro: Your profile is ready. Now let's put it to work: we research a relevant topic for your audience and write your first post with it.
content_studio_first_post_researching: Researching a relevant topic for your audience…
content_studio_first_post_drafting: Turning the strongest angle into your first post…
content_studio_first_post_wait: This takes one to three minutes. You can switch to another app or leave this page: we keep working, and your post waits here.
content_studio_first_post_research_faile: We couldn't research a topic for your first post.
content_studio_first_post_draft_failed: We found a topic, but couldn't write the post yet.
content_studio_first_post_not_placed: Your draft is ready, but it could not be placed in your post.
content_studio_first_post_apply: Put the draft in my post
content_studio_first_post_schedule_hint: Opens the post in the Postiz composer: choose your channels, make final edits and schedule or publish it there.
content_studio_first_post_success_hint: Content Studio used your profile and research preferences to help create it.
content_studio_research_fresh_breaking: Very current: the last few days
content_studio_research_fresh_evergreen: Lasting topics with a current hook
content_studio_research_angle_industry: What it means for the industry
content_studio_research_focus_hint: Content Studio uses this to decide which topics are worth bringing to you, for example for your first post.
content_studio_tour_radar_after_first_po: You just used research to create your first post. Radar is where Content Studio keeps an eye on new developments and content opportunities for your next posts.
content_studio_tour_home: Here you can see what's ready, what needs attention and what's coming up.
content_studio_tour_knowledge: Add trusted sources about your company, products and expertise so AI has stronger context.
content_studio_tour_creative: Create visuals that match your content and brand.
content_studio_tour_approvals: Review or approve content before it goes live.
content_studio_get_started_setup_hint: Your AI, company profile, voice, audiences, expertise and rules.
content_studio_get_started_first_post_hi: Research a current topic and turn it into a post.
content_studio_get_started_schedule_firs: Schedule or publish your first post
Open it in the composer and choose Schedule, or publish it.
content_studio_get_started_knowledge_hin: A page or feed about your company, products or field, so AI writes from it.
content_studio_get_started_research_hint: What Content Studio should look for and avoid when it researches topics.
content_studio_get_started_visual: Create a visual in Creative Studio
content_studio_get_started_visual_hint: An image for your posts, in your brand style.
content_studio_get_started_approval_hint: Choose whether a post must be approved before it goes to publishing (Require approval before handoff, under Editorial Policy), or confirm that no approval is needed.
content_studio_get_started_title: Get more out of Content Studio
content_studio_first_post_new_draft: A new draft is ready. Your post was changed in the meantime, so it was kept as it is.
content_studio_first_post_wait_kept: Your earlier drafts stay available: you can go back to any of them.
content_studio_first_post_angle_hint: Keep the same research focus and create a different post idea. This draft stays available.
content_studio_first_post_saved_text: The draft is safe. You can schedule it now or come back to it later.
content_studio_first_post_draft_date: Draft date: {{date}}. It stays a draft and will not be published until you schedule it.
content_studio_first_post_schedule_saved: Opens this same post in the composer: choose Schedule there.
content_studio_first_post_other_hint: Your saved draft stays in the calendar either way.
content_studio_first_post_earlier_draft_: Your earlier post is saved as a draft
content_studio_first_post_reminder_title: Your first post is still waiting
content_studio_first_post_reminder: You created your first AI-researched post. Want to review it once more and schedule it?
content_studio_first_post_reminder_ready: Your AI-researched draft is ready. Review it and schedule it when you're ready.
content_studio_home_first_post_waiting_t: Review it, then schedule or publish it.
content_studio_home_first_post_create_te: Content Studio researches a relevant topic and writes the post for you.
content_studio_home_reviews_text: Posts and designs waiting for a review or approval.
content_studio_setup_draft_again_with_ai: Draft a new profile with AI
content_studio_setup_saved_profile: This is your saved profile. Change what you like; nothing changes until you save, and Regenerate only runs when you press it.
content_studio_setup_first_post_exists: Your first post is waiting for you. Review it, edit it and decide whether to schedule or publish it.
content_studio_setup_save_open_first_pos: Save and open my first post
content_studio_handoff_back_confirm: Go back to Content Studio? Changes made here are not kept; your Content Studio draft stays as it is.
content_studio_handoff_finish: Schedule it here to finish your first post. Save for later keeps it as a draft.
content_studio_handoff_finish_scheduled: Your first post is already scheduled. Update saves your changes to it; Save for later turns it back into a draft.
content_studio_handoff_finish_published: Your first post is already published. There is nothing left to schedule.
content_studio_post_channel_missing: The channel of this post is no longer connected
content_studio_render_font_required: Enter the font family and choose a font file.
content_studio_render_font_too_large: The font file is larger than 32 MB.
content_studio_render_font_upload_hint: Use the family name exactly as your designs and Brand Kit name it. Uploading again for the same family, weight and style replaces the file for new renders.
content_studio_render_font_disabled: Disabled: new renders use the built-in font
content_studio_render_font_default_hint: Every design renders without setup: text in a font you have not uploaded is drawn with Noto Sans (Regular up to weight 500, Bold from 600; italic is drawn upright). Noto Sans is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
content_studio_render_font_load_error: Render fonts could not be loaded.
content_studio_render_font_none: No fonts uploaded. Designs use the built-in font.
content_studio_render_font_admin_hint: An organization administrator can upload your brand fonts.
content_studio_render_font_admin_require: Only organization administrators can manage render fonts.
content_studio_render_font_invalid: This file is not a font that can be used for rendering.
content_studio_render_font_unsupported: Use a single TrueType (.ttf) or OpenType (.otf) font file. Web fonts and font collections are not supported.
content_studio_render_font_limit: The organization already has the maximum number of active render fonts. Disable one first.
content_studio_render_font_conflict: This font changed at the same time. Try again.
content_studio_render_font_storage_unava: Private render font storage is not configured, so fonts cannot be uploaded yet. Designs still render with the built-in font.
content_studio_render_font_not_found: This render font no longer exists.
content_studio_render_font_error: The render font could not be saved. Try again.
content_studio_approval_admin_only: Only organization administrators decide on approval.
content_studio_approval_not_own: You requested this review, so another administrator approves it.
content_studio_policy_require_approval_a: Only organization administrators can change this.
